source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Simple allergic rhinitis, which does not typically explain persistent painless lymph-node enlargement accompanied by constitutional B symptoms.","B":"Lymphoma, because persistent lymphadenopathy with fever, drenching night sweats and unexplained weight loss is a classic concerning symptom pattern.","C":"Uncomplicated short-lived viral illness, which should not be assumed when lymphadenopathy persists together with significant unexplained systemic symptoms.","D":"Localized dermatitis, which may cause skin symptoms but does not account for persistent generalized lymphadenopathy and constitutional B symptoms."}}
source_row.rationale: Persistent painless lymphadenopathy with unexplained fever, drenching night sweats and weight loss is concerning for lymphoma and warrants diagnostic evaluation, including tissue diagnosis when indicated.
source_row.source_detail: Signs/symptoms section: painless swollen lymph nodes plus fever, drenching night sweats and unexplained weight loss are classic Hodgkin lymphoma findings; diagnosis requires tissue evaluation/biopsy. Current NCI PDQ adult Hodgkin lymphoma summary rechecked 2026-08-15. Reviewed 2026-08-15.

source_row.stem: A client has persistent painless lymphadenopathy with unexplained fever, drenching night sweats and weight loss. Which condition should be evaluated?
